items.quote: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD
items.claim: God spoke to Moses and identified himself as 'the LORD'

items.quote: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty
items.claim: God appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, identified by the name 'God Almighty'

items.quote: by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them
items.claim: The name JEHOVAH was not known to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
